title: Non-Linear Modelling in the Brazilian Market: Evaluating the Forecasting Performance of NN Univariate Nearest Neighbor and SNN Simultaneous Nearest Neighbour Forecasting Algorithm
authors: Marcelo S. Perlin, Paulo S. Ceretta
publication: REAd. Revista Eletrônica de Administração (Porto Alegre. Online)
journal: REAd. Revista Eletrônica de Administração (Porto Alegre. Online)
abstract: This paper presents an empirical evaluation of non-linear forecasting models applied to the Brazilian financial market. The study compares the predictive performance of Univariate Nearest Neighbor (NN) and Simultaneous Nearest Neighbour (SNN) forecasting algorithms in financial time series.
